question_cn: 车兵对车，弱方（单车一方）用Philidor防守的要点是：
question_en: In rook vs. rook+pawn, using the Philidor defense, the key point is:

options.text_cn: 车在兵的前面直接阻挡
options.text_en: Rook directly in front of the pawn to block

options.text_cn: 车在第6排截断对方王，兵过第6排后立即改用背后将军
options.text_en: Rook on 6th rank to cut off the king, then switch to back-rank checks when pawn passes

options.text_cn: 王主动进攻，车被动防守
options.text_en: King attacks actively while rook defends passively

options.text_cn: 车不断将军直到50步规则触发
options.text_en: Give endless checks until the 50-move rule triggers

explanation_cn: Philidor防守是车兵对车的核心和局技法：车在第6排截断 → 兵推过第6排时车立刻切到第1排背后将军 → 利用"将军距离"让对方王无法靠近 → 强制和局。
explanation_en: Philidor defense: rook on 6th rank cuts off the king → when pawn passes 6th rank, immediately switch to back-rank checks → checking distance prevents king approach → forced draw.
